_README: Ground-truth habits in events.db (the Oct 2026 data the Pi learned from), used to score habit precision/recall. Derived from source='user' commands grouped by day_type+slot, applying the Phase 7 floor (>=3 times AND >=60% of the days seen in that slot). 'fan' is the band (off / low=30 / half=50 / high=90); 'light' is the colour family (calm=blue/purple/cyan/magenta, bright=white/yellow, vivid=red/green, off). NOTE: rebuilt from events.db, not data/synthetic_events.db (a different, older September dataset).

habits.note: relax: fan low, light calm (earlier half of night)
bedtime: fan low, light off (later half of night)
late night: fan low, light off
weekend midday: light bright (fan varies low/high)
weekend morning: fan high, light bright (weak, only 3 days)
